Game Overview

At its heart, Animal Bus Traffic Jam is a puzzle game about join the cutest traffic puzzle adventure. Navigate a charming chaos of colorful buses and help delightful animal passengers find their ride in this whimsical match-3 challenge. Each level brings a heartwarming and clever logic test to untangle the bus-filled streets. Playful fun awaits every step of the way!
